data.message: I propose 10 tons each this month: 250 tons remain, so stock returns to 500 under either replenishment outcome. If we all maintain this limit, each earns $10,000 monthly indefinitely. Larger catches offer a short-term gain but risk shrinking or collapsing everyone's future income. I intend to request 10 tons and invite all 25 fishermen to adopt the same sustainable limit.
